purpose: Prospective CPU and total-container RAM limits, not equivalents of SBC hardware
measurement_policy: No full experiments in preparation. Freeze input hashes, image digest, actual cgroup values, selected candidates, order and repetitions before measured runs.
replay_policy: Independent producer outside detector CPU/memory cgroup. Existing replay spawns producer inside detector process tree: do not use unchanged for constrained timing claims.
failure_policy: Record startup failure, OOM, exit code, missing data and deadline miss. Do not silently remove failed configurations.
environment_policy: Use Linux ARM64 reference in same Docker VM; prior native macOS timings are not its unconstrained baseline. Do not stop unrelated containers automatically.
status: Prepared profiles, final measurement protocol pending readiness and workload review
